decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a cheap complement that supports the care range for installed floors, and holding it costs little while its value is still emerging.
The maintenance oil line underpins the surface-treatment offer for oiled floors at low carrying cost, and nothing so far indicates its value will not be realized.
Care products for oiled floors fit the established offer and are cheap to keep, so there is no case yet for abandoning the option.

Dropping the moisture-protection underlay already pruned the underlay range, which leaves the high-density foam less redundant, though it remains the most likely candidate for further pruning if results stay weak.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's flooring business in a growing industry, so the firm is more likely to commit further than to abandon it.
